name: Banh cuon
summary: Banh cuon is a thin steamed rice roll filled with minced pork and mushrooms. In Hanoi it is a light breakfast.
origin: Hanoi. The roll is eaten across the city in the morning.
texture: The sheet is soft, thin, and translucent.
howToEat: Fermented rice batter is steamed on a cloth over boiling water, filled with minced pork, mushrooms, and shallots, and rolled.
It comes with pork sausage and herbs. Dip it in a sweet-and-sour fish sauce.
where: Breakfast across Hanoi. The Michelin city tour names Bánh Cuốn Bà Xuân. An interview on the tourism site also names Hòe Nhai.
seoTitle: Banh cuon — Hanoi steamed rice rolls
seoDescription: What banh cuon is in Hanoi: a thin steamed rice roll with pork and mushrooms, eaten at breakfast, including Bánh Cuốn Bà Xuân.
